entries.text:
# Short Obligatory Prayer
## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon.

Me crava zaiga, o Mur Devel, che Tu kerdal man Ti pingiarap tut unt camap tut. Me ginava in cava ziro miri schwacha unt tiri zor, miri elenta unt tiri barvapen. Na hi vavrò Devel har Tu vri Tuter, holfa an u ferlocho, cova cai hi peske.
